Description: Design Review Modification to modify approved Use Permit #ZP2022-0113, to increase the number of dwelling units from 128 to 144, expanding the ground-level commercial space from 1,873 square foot to approximately 2,000 square foot, and removing the previously approved 14 parking spaces.
